product_overview: Mi Osusu is a fintech app for Sierra Leone that helps users join and manage Osusu savings groups, maintain personal vaults, and create savings goals. It also supports mobile money payments, KYC submission, and in-app notifications.
core_goals: Register and log in to access the app securely
Complete KYC so financial actions are unlocked
Create or join Osusu groups and manage group contributions
Top up and manage a personal vault balance
Create savings goals and track progress
Initiate mobile money payments for contributions and transfers
View notifications related to KYC, payments, and withdrawals

features.name: Authentication & Session
features.description: Users can create an account, log in with email or phone and password, verify with OTP, and request password resets to access the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /(auth)/register -> Enter name, phone, email, date of birth, address, and password -> Submit registration form -> Enter the received 6-digit OTP -> Verify the account -> See the main app
Navigate to /(auth)/login -> Enter email or +232 phone identifier -> Enter password -> Submit login form -> See the main app
Navigate to /(auth)/forgot-password -> Enter email address -> Request a password reset -> See confirmation that the reset request was submitted

features.name: KYC Submission & Review
features.description: Users submit identity documents, a selfie, and guarantor details so their account can be reviewed and approved for financial actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /(kyc)/details -> Enter identity and address details -> Continue to ID photos -> Capture or upload the National ID front image -> Capture or upload the National ID back image -> Continue to selfie capture -> Capture a live selfie -> Continue to guarantor details -> Enter guarantor information -> Submit KYC -> See KYC status as pending
Navigate to /(kyc)/pending -> View KYC status -> Return to KYC submission after a rejection -> Resubmit updated information and documents -> See KYC status as pending again

features.name: Vault
features.description: Users can view vault balances, top up through mobile money, and request withdrawals from their available funds.
user_flows: Navigate to /(main)/vault -> View posted, reserved, and available balances -> Enter a top-up amount -> Select Orange Money or AfriMoney -> Initiate the top-up -> See the returned USSD payment code
Navigate to /(main)/vault -> View available balance -> Request a withdrawal -> See the withdrawal request submitted

features.name: Savings Goals
features.description: Users create personal savings goals, deposit toward them from their balance, and withdraw funds when needed.
user_flows: Navigate to /(main)/savings -> Open goal creation -> Enter a target amount and deadline -> Create the savings goal -> See the new goal in the list with progress
Navigate to /(main)/savings -> Select an existing savings goal -> Deposit toward the goal -> See the goal progress increase
Navigate to /(main)/savings -> Select an existing savings goal -> Request a withdrawal from the goal -> See the withdrawal request submitted

features.name: Osusu Groups & Contributions
features.description: Users can create Osusu groups, discover public groups, join by invite code, assign collectors, and make contributions including physical collections.
user_flows: Navigate to /(groups)/create -> Enter contribution amount, frequency, members, and payout order -> Create the group -> See the new group details
Navigate to /(groups)/discover -> Search public groups -> Select a group -> Request to join -> See the join request submitted
Navigate to /(groups)/[id] -> View group details -> Assign a registered user as collector -> See the collector assignment saved
Navigate to /(groups)/physical-collect -> Enter collection details -> Record a physical collection -> See the collection added to the group ledger
Navigate to /(groups)/monime-payment -> Initiate a contribution payment -> Dial the displayed USSD code on the phone -> See live payment status updates

features.name: Payments & Webhooks
features.description: Users initiate mobile money payments and monitor the payment status after submission.
user_flows: Navigate to /(groups)/monime-payment -> Initiate payment -> Dial the displayed USSD code on the phone -> See live payment status updates

Navigate to /(send)/select -> Choose a recipient or payment target -> Continue to transfer details -> Enter the amount and payment method -> Continue to summary -> Confirm the transfer -> See the transfer submitted

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Users can open the notification inbox and review or mark notifications as read.
user_flows: Navigate to /components/notifications -> View the notification inbox -> Open a notification -> Mark the notification as read -> See the updated unread count

features.name: Profile & Account Settings
features.description: Users can review their profile and security-related settings from the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /components/profile -> View profile details -> Review KYC status and guarantor information -> Return to the main app
Navigate to /(settings)/change-password -> Enter current password -> Enter a new password -> Confirm the new password -> Submit the change -> See the password update confirmed

tech_stack: Supabase JS (Auth, Postgres, Storage, Edge Functions)
Monime (mobile money payments — Orange Money, AfriMoney)
Next.js 15 admin dashboard (apps/admin, separate app, server-side requireSuperAdmin)

routes.description: Pre-auth landing screen for new users
Login with email or +232 phone plus password; biometric and Google sign-in
Account registration with KYC-grade profile fields
Upload National ID front and back
Dashboard — groups summary, next due, vault/savings snapshot
Discover/search public groups and request to join
Assign a registered user as collector
Collector records a physical (cash/mobile money) collection
Monime USSD payment screen (dial code, poll status)

features.name: Authentication & Session
features.description: Email/phone + password login, registration, OTP, password reset, Google OAuth (PKCE), biometric unlock; session network-verified via getUser and stored encrypted
user_interactions: Submit login and land in main app
Register with name, phone, email, DOB, address, password

features.name: KYC Submission & Review
features.description: Upload ID front/back, selfie, guarantor; status gates financial actions; admin approves server-side
user_interactions: Capture/upload National ID front and back
View KYC status and resubmit if rejected

features.name: Vault
features.description: Server-authoritative balances; top-up via Monime USSD; pay Osusu and deposit savings from vault; withdrawals
user_interactions: Enter top-up amount and select Orange Money or AfriMoney

features.name: Savings Goals
features.description: Create goals, deposit from vault, withdraw with server balance validation, track progress
user_interactions: Create a goal with target amount and date

features.name: Osusu Groups & Contributions
features.description: Create/join groups, schedules, collector assignment, contribution payments via Monime, payouts
user_interactions: Create a group with amount, frequency, members, payout order
Initiate a contribution payment and receive USSD code

features.name: Payments & Webhooks
features.description: Initiate payment (USSD), poll status (display only), authoritative settlement via signed webhooks with idempotency

features.name: Withdrawals & Payouts
features.description: Member requests withdrawal; admin approves/rejects (DB role check, rejection reason required); Monime payout

features.name: Notifications
features.description: In-app inbox plus push; mark read; per-user RLS

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Separate Next.js app (apps/admin) with server-side requireSuperAdmin; KYC queue, users, groups, collectors, transactions, reports

known_limitations.issue: Frontend auth-gated flows require live Supabase configuration and a seeded test user; OTP requires a real email inbox
known_limitations.impact: End-to-end runs of signup/OTP/payment flows need test credentials and sandbox providers, otherwise they stop at the auth or provider step

known_limitations.issue: Web session tokens fall back to AsyncStorage (localStorage) on the web target, which is not encrypted and is XSS-readable
known_limitations.impact: XSS on the web build could exfiltrate the Supabase session

known_limitations.issue: Monime payment completion depends on signed provider webhooks; cannot be fully exercised without sandbox webhook simulation
known_limitations.impact: Payment settlement and idempotency paths require backend-level webhook tests, not browser E2E

known_limitations.issue: Admin dashboard is a separate Next.js app and is not part of the Expo web SPA build served for E2E
known_limitations.impact: Admin access-control tests must target the Next.js app separately
